Example
import WKnowledgeExtract from 'w-knowledge-extract/src/WKnowledgeExtract.mjs'

//零注入:僅 workDir 必填(金鑰放 workDir/.env;預設 AI 席位為免金鑰之免費模型)
let flow = WKnowledgeExtract.createKnowledgeExtract({
    workDir: './my-kb', //notes 集合中之筆記(摘要套件交出)與 relations 集合中之邊(關聯套件交出)即本套件之輸入
    data: { vocab: { domain: '天文學' } }, //主題範圍(選填), 未給即不限主題
})
let report = await flow.run() //提煉一輪, my-kb/knowledge/core 之核心 md 隨之更新, 結束後寫 log/<day>/<stamp>-run.json
console.log(report.ok)

  • 判定小組各席之票之文字(檔頭⑦;日誌、待判之理由與覆核紀錄之細節同一格式):<席>:<供應者>:<裁決>（<理由>）,各席以「；」相接; 裁決非物件者(未成立之標記等)原樣轉字串。各呼叫端之截斷與欄位為既有字樣(已見於日誌與待判),以選項保留

Source:

Example
console.log(voteTextOf({ votes: [{ seat: 'first', provider: 'p', verdict: { verdict: 'same', reason: '同一件事' } }, { seat: 'second', verdict: 'missing' }] }))
// => first:p:same（同一件事）；second:?:missing

weakEvidenceProblem(p, ctxopt) → {Object}

Description:

  • 弱證據參數須註明限制(ES13;新進之納入閘〔試套之結果〕與存量掃描同一判準):證據等級為最低級、未評估或不在清單者,conditions 須含限制語 (證據演算法之 selfLimitOf 判得為限制語,或含詞彙之弱證據說法 weakEvidence)

Source:
  • standards/coreStandards.mjs, line 111
Example
const ctx = { evidence: { levels: ['強', '中', '弱'], selfLimitOf: (x) => x.conditions.some((t) => /僅|限/.test(t)) } }
console.log(weakEvidenceProblem({ evidence: { level: '弱' }, conditions: [] }, ctx), weakEvidenceProblem({ evidence: { level: '弱' }, conditions: ['僅限單一觀測'] }, ctx), weakEvidenceProblem({ evidence: { level: '強' }, conditions: [] }, ctx))
// => { applies: true, ok: false, level: '弱' } { applies: true, ok: true, level: '弱' } { applies: false, ok: true, level: '強' }

 {}

withdrawSources(state, o) → {Object}

Description:

  • 撤出處／恢復(純函數,無 AI;刪除筆記之墓碑驅動):只有「非終態條目之出處」受影響時才升知識版本並寫沿革, 只影響略過、逾限或終態條目者只記 withdrawn(呼叫端落盤即 rev+1)

    恢復時,理由為「出處已撤他篇無支持」(檢定標準 ES8 之撤回)而出處含被恢復之筆記者一併還原(⑱;同一次升版,revived 列出)

Source:
  • stores/coreState.mjs, line 750
Example
const s = coreStateOf({ claims: [{ text: '甲', sources: ['n1'] }, { text: '乙', sources: ['n1', 'n2'] }] }).state
const r = withdrawSources(s, { withdraw: [{ id: 'n1', title: '甲筆記', reason: '刪除' }], at: 'T1' })
console.log(r.changed, r.bumped, Object.keys(r.state.withdrawn), liveSourcesOf(r.state.claims[1], r.state))
// => true true [ 'n1' ] [ 'n2' ]
Parameters:
Name Type Description
state Object

輸入狀態(不修改,回傳新狀態)
o Object

輸入 { withdraw:[{ id, title, reason }], restore:[id], at }
Returns:

回傳 { state, changed:Boolean(withdrawn 有增減), bumped:Boolean(升版), withdrawn:Array(id), restored:Array(id), affected:Array(條目 id), revived:Array(主張 id) }

Type
Object
